name: ShopCentral – Advanced Sales Booster Toolkit
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Stop slowing down your site with dozens of single-purpose plugins. ShopCentral is the lightweight, modular Ultimate Toolkit for WooCommerce that combines essential heavy-hitter features into one optimized, high-performance package.

🏆 Why ShopCentral?

Running a professional WooCommerce store often requires installing 5-10 extra plugins just to get basic functionality like a decent cart drawer, checkout field editing, or multi-store management. This leads to “plugin bloat”, conflicts, and slow site speeds.

ShopCentral solves this by consolidating the most essential e-commerce tools into one professionally coded plugin. Our Modular Performance Architecture means if you don’t enable a feature (like the Store Manager), its code doesn’t function—keeping your site lightning fast.

🔥 5 Essential Modules in 1 Plugin

1. 🛒 Interactive Slide Cart (Mini Cart Drawer)

Replace the default, boring theme cart with a modern, conversion-focused Slide Cart that keeps customers engaged.
* Auto-Opening Drawer: A smooth slide-out animation allows users to view their cart without leaving the page.
* Real-Time AJAX Updates: Instantly updates totals and quantities without refreshing the page.
* Smart Floating Icon: Uses intelligent detection to position itself away from chat widgets (WhatsApp, Tidio, Messenger) so it never gets blocked.
* Sticky Footer: Ensures the “Proceed to Checkout” button is always visible to reduce cart abandonment.
* Universal Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Astra, OceanWP, Divi, Elementor, and 99% of other themes.

2. 📝 Checkout Field Editor (Checkout Manager)

Take full control of your checkout page layout and fields. No coding required.
* Add Custom Fields: Easily add new Text, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Datepicker, and File Upload fields to your checkout.
* Conditional Logic: Magically show or hide fields based on user input (e.g., “Show VAT ID field only if ‘Company’ is filled”).
* Role-Based Visibility: Show specific fields only to certain user roles (perfect for B2B/Wholesale).
* Optimize Layout: Hide unnecessary fields, mark fields as required/optional, and organize them into half or full-width layouts.

3. 🏬 Multi-Store Manager & Analytics

Manage your other WooCommerce websites directly from this site!
Turn your current store into a “Command Center” to control and monitor multiple websites without logging into each one separately.
* Centralized Control: Connect unlimited external WooCommerce sites and manage them all from this dashboard.
* Unified Analytics: View aggregated Revenue, Orders, and Top Products for ALL your stores in one place.
* Secure Connection: Connects via standard WooCommerce REST API keys for safe, encrypted management.
* No “Main Site” Lag: Uses a smart proxy system that fetches data remotely, ensuring your main site remains fast.

4. ➕ Advanced Product Addons

Sell personalized products and significantly increase your Average Order Value (AOV).
* Unlimited Options: Add custom fields like Gift Messages, Engraving Text, Size Selectors, and Checkboxes to your product pages.
* Dynamic Pricing: Charge extra fees for add-ons. Support for Flat Fees (+$5.00) or Percentage Fees (+10%).
* Global & Granular Control: Create add-on groups that apply to All Products, specific Categories, or individual items.

5. 🎁 Conversion & Upsell Widgets

Small tools that make a huge difference in sales.
* Free Shipping Progress Bar: Display a dynamic bar (“Spend $15 more for Free Shipping!”) to encourage larger cart sizes.
* Free Gift Triggers: Automatically add a free gift to the cart when a customer spends above a certain amount.
* Widget Placements: Inject custom content or upsells before/after the cart and checkout forms easily.

🚀 Developer Friendly & Performance Focused

  • Clean Code: Written with modern PHP standards and React-powered admin interfaces.
  • No Bloat: Unused modules are completely disabled to ensure zero impact on frontend performance.
  • Translation Ready: Fully localized and ready for translation.

🔒 Privacy & Intelligent Analytics

To power the Multi-Store Manager and provide you with actionable business insights, ShopCentral aggregates anonymous, non-sensitive store performance metrics (such as order counts, revenue trends, and product popularity).

We prioritize your privacy:
* No Personal Data: We do NOT collect or store your customers’ names, emails, addresses, or payment information.
* Purpose Driven: This data is strictly used to generate your centralized analytics dashboard and to provide personalized recommendations that help you grow your store.
* Transparency: You retain full control over your connected stores and data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shopcentral directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ShopCentral menu in your dashboard to choose which modules to enable.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes! ShopCentral is designed to be compatible with all major WooCommerce themes. The Slide Cart includes heavy-duty CSS overrides ensuring it displays correctly over any theme’s default cart.

Can I use just one feature?

Absolutely. ShopCentral is modular. You can enable just the “Checkout Editor” and leave the “Slide Cart” and “Store Manager” disabled.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, ShopCentral is fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (formerly Custom Order Tables).

  • New: Multi-Store Manager with remote analytics.
  • New: Advanced Conditional Logic for Checkout Fields.
  • New: Smart Chat Widget detection for Slide Cart icon.
  • Improvement: Enhanced SEO friendly description and modular architecture.
